caseStudies.title: Deliver My Project
caseStudies.summary: A structured project-delivery journey that turns a project requirement into a clear and actionable delivery request.
caseStudies.challenge: Create a clear path for clients to explain what they need, what outcome they expect, their timeline, and budget.
caseStudies.solution: The visitor follows a structured delivery journey that validates the request and sends the information through the backend for review and action.
caseStudies.outcome: A clearer project intake process with stronger communication and a more structured route into delivery.
caseStudies.businessValue: Better project clarity, stronger communication, and a clearer starting point for technology delivery.

caseStudies.title: Mentor Me
caseStudies.summary: A focused mentoring journey for technology professionals who need practical guidance around technical challenges, learning, and execution.
caseStudies.challenge: Provide a simple way to explain a technical challenge, learning need, or execution goal before a mentoring conversation.
caseStudies.solution: The journey structures the request so the mentoring conversation can start with context, focus, and a clear objective.
caseStudies.outcome: A focused mentoring experience with clearer priorities and a defined next step.
caseStudies.businessValue: Faster decision-making, clearer priorities, and more practical use of mentoring time.

caseStudies.title: Coffee With Me
caseStudies.summary: A focused conversation journey for discussing technology, engineering, product delivery, career development, and professional ideas.
caseStudies.challenge: Create a low-friction but intentional way to start a useful professional conversation.
caseStudies.solution: The journey gives the visitor a clear route into a focused conversation around a specific topic or question.
caseStudies.outcome: A more intentional conversation with a clear purpose and useful direction.
caseStudies.businessValue: Clearer expectations, stronger communication, and a better foundation for future collaboration.
